chain: Owner: on my phone the expense tracker's dashboard cards run off the right edge. Fix the layout so they fit.
claim: Fixed the layout: the cards now wrap and fit on phones.
evidence:
- `npm test`: 24 passed
- `npm run build`: ok
- `npm run screens`: screenshots of the dashboard at 1440 and 390, light and dark
  - before: dashboard-390-light-before.png (cards cut off on the right)
  - after: dashboard-390-light.png, dashboard-1440-light.png (cards wrap, nothing cut off)
